lines: Before breakfast, Mia, Sol and Tavi met in the star room. The Star Door was shut.
A note came through the letter box and landed next to Mia.
Mia picked up the note and opened it.
I found a note! It says: Find nothing. Five clues will show the way.
Find nothing? That is a funny thing to look for. Let's follow the clues!
Let's stay together and look carefully. First, can you spot Mia's note?
You found the note. Look at the five star outlines at the top. None are gold yet. Each clue will turn one star gold. The first arrow points to the parcel!
The friends followed the arrow across the room. It pointed to a parcel.
I opened the parcel. Look! My brown teddy is inside.
The first clue says to move the teddy. Tap the toy to lift it out. Then tap the box and look inside.
You moved the teddy outside and looked inside. The box is empty. Empty means there is no toy inside this box. The box is still here.
They had found an empty box, not a thing called nothing. The first star turned gold. A blue door opened.
The friends went through the door. They entered a room with three big bells.
Hello! I am Nori. I listen for tiny sounds. May I help you check the bell room?
Yes, please. The note tells us to find nothing. We found an empty box in the first room. Let's check the bells next.
The wind stopped, and the big bell stopped moving. Hold the bell while we stay quiet and listen.
The bell did not ring while we listened. I heard my breath, and the bell stayed right there. We found a quiet bell, not a thing called nothing.
The bell did not ring, but it was still there. The second star turned gold. A door opened to the paper room.
I found a white card on this table. Look, there are no marks on it yet.
Touch the card. You can draw a mark, or choose Leave blank and do not draw.
If you drew, there is a mark on the card. If you did not draw, the card is blank. Blank means there is no mark on the card. The card is still here both times.
The card stayed there with or without a mark. The third star lit. Then seven wall tiles lit up, one after another.
Each glowing tile shows one letter. Read them from left to right with me!
The seven letters spell the word nothing. We can see and read the word. The word does not show us a thing called nothing.
The written word stayed on the tiles, so the fourth star lit. A gold arrow appeared on the floor and led the friends to a red curtain.
My teddy rolled out of my bag! It crossed the floor and went behind the curtain. I saw where it went, but I cannot see it now!
Slide the curtain slowly. Let's see what is behind it.
There is the teddy. Hidden means it was there, but the curtain stopped us from seeing it. The toy did not disappear.
Opening the curtain showed the teddy. The fifth star turned gold. Now all five stars were gold, and the Star Door opened.
Behind the Star Door were two small doors. Door A had a white card on its shelf. Door B had an empty shelf.
My note still says, Find nothing. Tap both small doors. We must look at each one before we answer.
Door A showed a card. Door B showed an empty shelf. Neither door showed a thing called nothing.
The friends solved the note's puzzle. Mia folded the note. Everyone carried the five-star map into the library before going home.
Before we put the map away, let's remember the first clue. Which thing became empty after you moved Sol's teddy outside?

The box became empty after the teddy moved outside, but the box stayed in the room. Then Mia put the finished map in the library stand. A little door opened high in the wall. A parcel slid down a ramp and stopped beside the map. Its label said Mia, Sol and Tavi. Their next adventure had arrived.

Here is the lesson. There is no thing called nothing for us to find. We found an empty box, a quiet bell, a blank card, the written word nothing, and a hidden teddy. Each time, something was still there. This matters because careful words tell other people exactly what you saw, heard, or found.
